children: Activist investor Starboard Value wants construction company Knife River to commit to narrowing the gap between its earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization margins and those of its peers in the next few years.
Starboard also wants the company to evaluate strategic alternatives including a potential sale.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
